newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land buys Parkway stake.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land buys Parkway stake.

text.p: Property group DBS Land Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy 60.18 million Parkway Holdings Ltd shares at Singapore $6.50 each.
A DBS Land statement said the company would acquire the stake from Pantai Healthcare (Cayman) Ltd, a unit of Malaysia's Hospital Pantai.
The purchase will be paid in cash and will be financed by internal resources and bank borrowings.
DBS Land said: "The acquisition will broaden the group's earnings base and is consistent with the group's strategy to be a major regional healthcare provider."
Parkway is a diversified property and healthcare group and owns several private hospitals in Singapore.
DBS Land has identified healthcare as a new core business for the group.
DBS Land's existing health care business includes a 25 percent stake in an 82-bed hospital in Penang. It has also started work on two 200-bed hospitals in Malaysia.
Group chief operating officer Han Cheng Fong had said in the company's latest annual report that the group might consider acquisitions of operating hospitals to advance its growth.
DBS Land has requested the Stock Exchange of Singapore to lift suspension of trading in its shares on Wednesday.
